src/app/App.tsx.name: App root
src/app/App.tsx.description: Puts the router inside the shared providers; the top of the screen tree.

src/app/AppCrash.tsx.name: Whole-app crash screen
src/app/AppCrash.tsx.description: Catches a crash anywhere in the app and shows a last-resort error screen instead of a blank page.

src/app/Devtools.tsx.name: Developer panels
src/app/Devtools.tsx.description: Adds the developer panels for data loading and page routing, only when asked for.

src/app/nav.ts.name: Menu layout
src/app/nav.ts.description: Lists the app's areas and pages as the sidebar and top bar show them.

src/app/NotFound.tsx.name: Page not found
src/app/NotFound.tsx.description: Shows "not found" inside the frame, so the menus keep working.

src/app/optionalPlugins.d.ts.name: Optional plugin list type
src/app/optionalPlugins.d.ts.description: Tells the code what shape the build's list of optional plugins has.

src/app/plugins.ts.name: Plugin register
src/app/plugins.ts.description: The single list of every widget and data source the app ships with.

src/app/PluginsProvider.tsx.name: Plugin hand-out
src/app/PluginsProvider.tsx.description: Makes the plugins, plus one data source per saved connection, available to every screen.

src/app/Providers.test.tsx.name: Shared setup tests
src/app/Providers.test.tsx.description: Checks the shared setup wraps screens with everything they need.

src/app/Providers.tsx.name: Shared setup
src/app/Providers.tsx.description: Wraps every screen with theme, data loading, messages, vault and plugins; tests and stories use the same setup.

src/app/queryClient.test.ts.name: Data loading rule tests
src/app/queryClient.test.ts.description: Checks when loading errors show inline and when they pop up as a message.

src/app/queryClient.ts.name: Data loading rules
src/app/queryClient.ts.description: Sets how data is fetched and cached app-wide, and is the one place loading errors turn into messages.

src/app/RouteError.tsx.name: Page error screen
src/app/RouteError.tsx.description: Shows a page's loading or display error inside the content area, with retry; the frame keeps working.

src/app/router.test.ts.name: Page routing tests
src/app/router.test.ts.description: Checks the router finds the right page for an address.

src/app/router.ts.name: Page routing
src/app/router.ts.description: Builds the router that maps web addresses to pages, under the site's base address.

src/app/withConnections.test.ts.name: Connection data source tests
src/app/withConnections.test.ts.description: Checks saved connections turn into usable data sources only when their type is in the build.

src/app/withConnections.ts.name: Connections as data sources
src/app/withConnections.ts.description: Adds one data source per saved connection whose plugin is in this build.

src/main.tsx.name: Start-up
src/main.tsx.description: Starts the app in the browser and turns on error reporting.
